name: simple-hack
description: Run a hosted hackathon with event management, team sites, judging and results through Simple Hack.

interface.longDescription:
Create a free hackathon on simple-hack.app and manage it with your assistant. Set the event page, schedule, join and judge links, stages, and judging rubric. Participants sign in, form teams, publish team sites, and submit their projects. Judges score assigned projects, and organisers export scores and results.

Connect with Manage my events for the ten organiser tools. A separate team connection lets a participant publish only their own team's site. The run-hackathon skill also explains the browser and API workflows, plus an optional private, self-hosted event on the organiser's cloud account.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a draft hackathon for our student club in November
Show my hackathon events and the stage of each one
Help me set the judging rubric for my event

publication.release_notes: First Simple Hack package: hosted event management skill, ten organiser MCP tools, and scoped team-site publishing guidance.
